name: Greenhouses
summary: Greenhouses consists of low parallel glass gable ranges linked down the middle, built on low concrete bases with closely spaced silver frames.

evidence.note: core-1m surface minus local ground: median 3.71 m, 90th percentile 4.24 m, maximum 5.42 m.
Western Facilities Management exterior photograph; masonry, trim and opening proportions assessed against the orthophoto.
Low northern headhouse has a horizontal band of glazing and a single opaque door facing the service lane.
Three narrow parallel glazed ranges lie south of the broader headhouse. Open slots between the ranges produce the comb-like footprint.
PIL mean wall or glazing sample, source-pixel rectangle (x, y, width, height) (116, 108, 4, 4) gives #747975.
An enclosed plot runs south of the glass ranges. The 2025 city image resolves a pair of low service structures and two rows of narrow growing beds with open paths.

parts.name: Pale service hut beside growing beds

notes: Each gable has a mostly glazed triangular end and thin rafters and roof glazing bars. The headhouse is opaque-roofed.
